purpose: Verified historical video companions for Dynamic Texture Editing (SCCG 2015).
selection_rule: Only files with a frame-level or direct semantic match to a published figure/table are included here.

files.relation: Figure 9: the frame itself is titled 'Enlarged texture (time shift)'.
Table 2 / Grass2: 617 RANSAC inliers from 720 ORB ratio-test matches to the recovered raster.
Table 2 / Fence: 224 RANSAC inliers from 497 ORB ratio-test matches to the recovered raster.
Table 2 / Tree in the rain: arrangement no.3, with 360 RANSAC inliers from 424 ORB ratio-test matches to the recovered raster.

limitations: The paper's LaTeX names no video files, so the archive-to-publication relation is documented evidence, not a claim of original encoded-master identity.
The six-file audit also contains no2.mpg and ladvi_full.mpg; their exact figure mapping is unresolved and they are intentionally not included here.
Figure 10's damaged-grass inpainting video has not yet been identified among the downloaded files.
